sources.name: Lake County government calendar (lakecountyco.gov)
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. The connection reset on fetch; not retried. Search results list lakecountyco.com as the county's site and say its offices include the Leadville Public Library and Ski Cooper. No county page was read. Upgraded 10 November 2026: lakecountyco.com now redirects to www.lakecountyco.gov, a CivicPlus (CivicEngage) site; the first fetch reset and the second answered 200. Its calendar RSS (RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=All-calendar.xml, with calendarEvent:EventDates, EventTimes and Location) answered 200 with 2 items, both in the next 30 days and both in Leadville: 'CANCELLED - Lake County Tourism Panel Monthly Meeting' (12 Nov, 113 E. 5th St) and Planning Commission Meeting (23 Nov, 4-6 pm, 505 Harrison Ave). The calendar page lists six categories (Board of County Commissioners Meetings, Conservation District, Regional Housing Authority, Main Calendar, Planning Commission, Visit Leadville / Twin Lakes Tourism) and shows 23 commissioners' meetings that the RSS did not carry, so the feed is short. Public meetings only, no community events. robots.txt: /RSS.aspx and /rss.aspx (the feed index) and /common/modules/icalendar/ are disallowed, so the iCal export was not fetched; /RSSFeed.aspx is not disallowed; Crawl-delay 10. Needs: a title exclusion for 'CANCELLED' if the reader does not take it as a status.

sources.name: Visit Leadville Twin Lakes (Lake County Tourism Panel) community calendar
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. The tourism site for Leadville and Twin Lakes, with the visitor center at 460 Harrison Ave (719-486-3900, summer hours daily 10-5). /events/ is a community-submitted calendar (an Add Event form at /events/community/add/): on 10 October it showed 12 October 2026 items, among them live music and trivia at the Pastime Saloon (120 W 2nd St), Trivia Tuesdays at The Famous (313 Harrison), Thursday family bingo at the Elks Lodge (123 W 5th), trivia and a paint-and-sip at FREIGHT (320 E 9th), Cloud City Mead's anniversary (609 D Hwy 24), a Community Fall Fest and Haunted Hills run at Colorado Mountain College (901 S Hwy 24), and a Victorian Spirits talk at the Healy House (Oct 16, 5:30 pm, $8-10, staged). Treated as an aggregator for everyone else's events; its own items (OctoberVille: fireworks and parade rescheduled to October 17, no time) are the only ones it can source. Home page also links /listing-category/annual-events/, /know-before-you-go/ (fire closures) and business directories. Page title still said February-March 2025 while listing October 2026. No feed found. Upgraded 10 November 2026: the calendar is The Events Calendar (WordPress) and /events/?ical=1 answered 200 text/calendar with 30 VEVENTs (the plugin's page of 30), 10 November 2026 to 3 April 2027, every one with a LOCATION carrying venue and street address. 19 fall in the next 30 days, all in Leadville (none in Twin Lakes): Trivia Tuesdays at The Famous, trivia at the Pastime Saloon, Thursday family bingo at the Elks Lodge (5 dates), Veterans Appreciation Luncheon at the Senior Center (13 Nov), Alpine Orchestra at The Old Church (13 Nov), The Silver Social (14 Nov), Cribbage Night and a 'Party' at FREIGHT, Warren Miller film night and Opening Day at Ski Cooper, Taste of Leadville and Leadville Main Street's Parade of Lights (4 Dec), a wreath workshop at the library (5 Dec), Steam and Stitches at FREIGHT (6 Dec), Victorian Ghost Stories at the Tabor Home (10 Dec). robots.txt allows /events/ and disallows /wp-json/, so the iCal feed is the one to use, not the REST one (which was fetched twice before the robots file was read, and showed the same 19). Needs filtering: it is a community-submitted board, so each item wants its organizer's page; weekly trivia and bingo are regulars; 'Party at FREIGHT' is FREIGHT's 'Client Party'; items also appear in the Ski Cooper, FREIGHT and library feeds.

sources.name: Lake County Public Library
excludeTitles: ^Make & Take Club--- Club de Crear y Llevar$
sources.notes: Read 10 October 2026. Home page gives 1115 Harrison Ave, 719-486-0569 and hours (Mon, Wed 10-6; Tue, Thu, Fri 10-5; Sat 12-4; Sun closed), published as a place. /library-events-calendar rendered only its heading (events load in the browser), and /events-programs is a hub for Kids (0-11), Teens (12-17), Adults and the annual Banned Books Week Celebration, without dates. Only dates seen: a 2026 copyright and 'Library Service Disruptions August 3 & 4' with no year. Look for a feed or a calendar URL that renders server-side. Upgraded 10 November 2026: /library-events-calendar embeds a Tockify calendar (tockify.com/lcplcalevents, 'Library Events Calendar'), which is why the page rendered empty. Its iCal feed, https://tockify.com/api/feeds/ics/lcplcalevents, answered 200 text/calendar: 536 VEVENTs from 1 October 2026 to June 2028, one per occurrence (no RRULE), times in UTC, time zone America/Denver. 37 fall in the next 30 days, all the library's own; 29 once two closure days, an early closing, three cancelled sessions and two Board of Trustees meetings are set aside. They are mostly weekly clubs: Tuesday D&D, Little Explorers Club, Tiny Tales & Playtime, Magic: The Gathering Club, Minecraft Club, Make & Take Club, Lego Robotics, plus Adult Bookclub (at Treeline Kitchen), Tarot Tarts, Craft Anarchy, a Wreath Making Workshop (5 Dec) and Colorado Workforce hours. LOCATION is blank, a room ('AMAX Room') or the library's address, hence the default venue. robots.txt: tockify.com disallows /api/ for every agent, so under 'honor' ingest will not read this feed; it is the calendar's own subscribe feed, and reading it weekly is the editor's 'subscribe' decision (Windsor's tockify-com entry is the same case). Suggested title exclusions for the editor: 'Library Closed', 'LIBRARY CLOSES', 'Cancel' (the feed writes *Cancelled* and *Canceled* into the title), 'Board of Trustees', and the 'AMAX Room:' room bookings (Quilt Guild). robots: subscribe from 10 November 2026, the owner's call: the host's robots.txt disallows the path, and this is the calendar the organization publishes for subscription; one weekly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "The owner subscribes to the calendar feeds"). Exclusions widened 10 November 2026 after a dry run staged 112 items in 120 days: the weekly and monthly standing clubs, the storytime, the workforce and legal-clinic hours and a room booking are kept out, as on the other guides' library feeds, which leaves the workshops and one-off programs.

sources.name: FREIGHT Leadville
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. FREIGHT is the event venue at 320 East 9th Street, Leadville, with the Boxcar Bar; the Visit Leadville Twin Lakes calendar already lists its events. The site is WordPress with The Events Calendar. /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events?per_page=50 answered 200: 69 upcoming events over 2 pages, each with venue FREIGHT, 320 East 9th Street. 19 fall in the next 30 days, but 17 of them are 'BOXCAR BAR OPEN' (the bar's opening evenings, Thursday to Sunday at 5 pm, entered as events; 45 of the first 50 items); the other two are Cribbage Night at the Boxcar Bar (19 Nov, 6 pm) and 'Client Party at FREIGHT' (2 Dec, a private booking by its name). Motherlode Holiday Market 2026 at FREIGHT (11-13 Dec) is just past the 30 days. So about 1 public event in the window. /events/?ical=1 also answers (text/calendar, capped at 30 VEVENTs, reaching only 24 December because of the bar entries), which is why the REST feed is proposed; /events/feed/ is the plugin's plain RSS, not a format ingest reads. robots.txt: 'Allow: /' for every agent. Needs title exclusions before it is any use: 'BOXCAR BAR OPEN' and 'Client Party'. No feed categories are set.

sources.name: Lake County High School calendar (Lake County School District)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The district's home page (lakecountyschools.net, WordPress) embeds six public Google Calendars; their iCal addresses were each fetched once. 'Lake County High School' (this feed): 3,679 VEVENTs back to 2014, 30 with RRULE; 13 single items in the next 30 days, 9 of them at the Leadville schools: the theatre production 'When Bad Things Happen to Good Actors' (three performances, 13-14 Nov), three middle-school boys' basketball home games, two grade-level Thanksgiving lunches, and the Winter Band/Choir Concert (8 Dec, 7 pm); the other four are away games and a college visit, which the location filter drops. About 4 to 7 listable a month. The other five: 'Lake County District' (hme83cf7l97hpagjorp88eakc4@group.calendar.google.com; 2 in the window, a policy council meeting and a no-school day), 'Lake County Intermediate School' (last item June 2026), 'The Center and Early Childhood' (last item 2023), 'CCHS Website Calendar' (2 in the window) and 'Lake County Elementary School' (3: Thanksgiving lunches and a house party); none worth a feed of its own. The site's /events/feed/ is an empty comments feed. robots.txt: calendar.google.com disallows everything but its home page for every agent, so under 'honor' ingest will not read this; a public calendar's iCal address is a subscribe link, and that call is the editor's (Elizabeth's pplibraries-org-district entry is the same case). Suggested title exclusions: 'Thanksgiving Lunch', 'College Trip'. The district's sports schedule is linked separately at gobound.com/co/schools/lakecountyhs/calendar (not read). robots: subscribe from 10 November 2026, the owner's call: the host's robots.txt disallows the path, and this is the calendar the organization publishes for subscription; one weekly read is what a subscribed calendar does (DECISIONS.md, "The owner subscribes to the calendar feeds").
